quarterly_data.quarter: DigitalOcean press release: DigitalOcean and Bright Data Unlock the Web for AI Agents (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner Bright Data: DigitalOcean and Bright Data announced a partnership that brings Bright Data's search, access, extract and actioning tools and datasets to DigitalOcean Managed Agents, available now through Action Gateway in the Managed Agents public preview, without a separate Bright Data account or API key. The partnership will extend in two additional phases: Bright Data's datasets will be integrated into DigitalOcean's Agent Data Services, and Bright Data plans to build and deploy its own agents on DigitalOcean Managed Agents. CEO Paddy Srinivasan: 'Bright Data brings search and retrieval into the DigitalOcean's AI-Native Cloud, which handles all the key resources an agent needs, including the runtime, session state, inference, and tool access.'
